{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_ages = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

print(f'Mean age of customers (excluding missing age entries): {mean_age:.2f}')"}
